meta.title: Competitor Radar
meta.niche: US sales tax compliance software for mid-market ecommerce and SaaS brands

analysis.summary: TaxCloud goes after switchers harder than anyone: 24 comparison pages and 17 case studies. Rivals mostly publish state guides and webinars, and Numeral and Zamp lean on customer stories.

points.text: TaxCloud runs 24 comparison pages, many aimed at Avalara users, and 33 pages written for buyers. That is the clearest switcher focus in the set.
Kintsugi has 17 comparison pages, covering Avalara, TaxJar, Anrok, Numeral, Zamp and Vertex. It is now fighting for the same switchers.
Numeral has 23 case studies and Zamp has 19, mostly ecommerce brands. TaxCloud has 17, so proof-by-customer is a crowded lane.

shared.title: Customer story libraries
shared.text: Numeral (23), Zamp (19) and TaxCloud (17) publish many customer stories. Proof is table stakes now, so TaxCloud needs sharper results and mid-market names to stand out.

shared.title: State-by-state guides
shared.text: Avalara, TaxJar, Numeral and Kintsugi publish state pages on nexus, shipping tax and filing. They own early-stage searches, so TaxCloud's 105 state pages face heavy competition.

shared.title: Rival alternatives pages
shared.text: TaxCloud, Kintsugi and Zamp write about Avalara pricing or alternatives. Switchers will see rivals' framing of Avalara, so TaxCloud must keep its own pages current.

gaps.title: Switching playbook hub
gaps.text: Only TaxCloud and Anrok have a switching guide, each with one page. TaxCloud could build a full kit covering data export, timelines, filing handover and checklists.

gaps.title: Avalara IPO and customer risk
gaps.text: TaxCloud has one page on the Avalara IPO. Nobody else covers what it means for pricing and support. A series could catch worried customers.

gaps.title: Ecommerce migration case studies
gaps.text: Numeral and Zamp show brands but not the switch itself. TaxCloud could publish before-and-after stories, with costs and effort, from mid-market brands leaving a named provider.
